renderer_frames.limits: Static actual WebGL frames at selected full/low LOD, gaze, unilateral, half and full closure. No pixel visibility verdict, continuous collision proof, anatomical reference, speech synthesis or physical AV.

provenance.reviewer: AUTOMATED TEST, NOT A HUMAN REVIEWER
provenance.method: Arbitrary neighbouring vertices exercise browser sampling only, not lip/teeth/tongue contact

synthetic_contact_transport.limits: Rendered skinned/morphed vertex or barycentric point distances in metres, compared to supplier-declared ranges. Externally supplied three-vertex weighted anchors are not checked for triangle membership; the capture picker does return a hit triangle. Not a continuous surface collision test or independent quality verdict. Reviewer identity, landmark anatomy and independence require external review.

fibers.method: Tapered curved opaque ribbons; per-vertex source-nearest anchors retain original skin weights and all source morph positions; layered brow flow is projected above the rest skin surface. Not a strand simulation or full-blink approval.

eye_clearance.activation: smoothstep at original blink 0.7..1, zero at neutral/half blink

eye_coverage.limits: Model-space forward orthographic sampled coverage, not all-view continuous collision proof, corneal thickness, anatomical approval or physical AV. Original source geometry/morphs are retained.

surface_shading.limits: Vertex-depth oral light attenuation (not ray-traced AO), ivory teeth, low-glint brow/lash fibers, balanced lighting; authored recipe maps when supplied, procedural fallback otherwise; opt-in masked single-pass wrap approximation (not physical SSS); no scanned pores or subsurface transport. Wet coated eyes and anisotropic cards; no corneal geometry, strands, voxel scattering or native changes.

fresh_actual_talking.limits: Actual WebGL/stock CPU speech; not generated imagery. Offline fixed-WAV-clock render, not physical AV, subjective realism approval, native appearance parity or measured i5 performance.
